governance_id_crosswalk.purpose: Restores original Stage 3A canonical decision taxonomy (DEC-01 through DEC-06) and establishes an explicit sub-decision hierarchy to resolve title drift and taxonomic inconsistencies introduced in Stage 3B-R reports.

DEC-01.stage3a_scope: Selection of primary and secondary market data providers for prospective evaluation.
DEC-01.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: Stage 3B-R text report labeled DEC-01 as 'Protocol Pre-registration', displacing provider selection.

DEC-02.stage3a_scope: Verification of contractual non-display usage, derived works storage, and post-termination purge rules.
DEC-02.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: Stage 3B-R text report labeled DEC-02 as 'Provider Rights Clearance' (substantively aligned, but overconfident in asserting Tiingo Power 'FEASIBLE' and Alpaca 'COMPLIANT').

DEC-03.stage3a_scope: Formulation of hypotheses, test statistics, and significance thresholds.
DEC-03.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: Stage 3B-R text report misassigned DEC-03 to 'Operational Circuit Breakers', moving statistical inferential protocol to DEC-01.

DEC-03.A.title: Causal Session Eligibility
DEC-03.A.scope: Strict ex-ante regime determination (I_def,T = 1 iff S_{T-1} == DEFENSIVE) and formal rejection of post-treatment collider conditioning (R_{m,T} < 0).

DEC-03.B.title: Statistical Size Calibration
DEC-03.B.scope: Dual Newey-West HAC + Stationary Block Bootstrap gatekeeper. Empirical size calibration shows joint rule remains oversized (7.7% - 8.9%) at N=30.

DEC-03.C.title: Secondary Return Constraint
DEC-03.C.scope: Maximum allowable annualized return drag: Delta CAGR = CAGR(D2) - CAGR(E0) >= -200 bps.

DEC-04.stage3a_scope: Sample size floor, target evaluation duration, and interim stopping rules.
DEC-04.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: Stage 3B-R text report misassigned DEC-04 to 'Execution Latency Benchmark', displacing sample size rules.

DEC-04.A.title: Sampling Quota Floor
DEC-04.A.scope: Inverse sampling quota design requiring minimum N_def >= 30 causal risk-off sessions before primary inference is computed.

DEC-04.B.title: Administrative Horizon & Extension
DEC-04.B.scope: Baseline horizon of 252 sessions with administrative extension up to 504 sessions if N_def quota is unfulfilled. Absolute prohibition on p-value peeking.

DEC-05.stage3a_scope: Fail-closed circuit breakers, latency bounds, and operator recovery procedures.
DEC-05.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: Stage 3B-R text report misassigned DEC-05 to 'Horizon & Sampling Design', moving monitoring architecture out of place.

DEC-05.A.title: Fail-Closed Incident Lock
DEC-05.A.scope: Automatic operational suspension upon 3 consecutive missing bars, single-day slippage > 50 bps, or allocation divergence > 2%.

DEC-05.B.title: Latency and Data Availability
DEC-05.B.scope: Hardware/network socket ingestion latency profiling and bar delivery timestamp audit.

DEC-05.C.title: Operator Recovery Controls
DEC-05.C.scope: Manual intervention protocols and reconciliation runbooks for state resumption.

DEC-06.stage3a_scope: Explicit human authorization required before executing any forward live or paper orders.
DEC-06.stage3b_r_mismatch_detected: None. Title and blocked status remained consistent across all stages.

governance_rule_invariants.activation_authorization: BLOCKED (Requires human owner explicit action; zero agent activation authority permitted)
